title: GO LIVE — Deploy, Wire Auth/Analytics, Activate Billing
source: MASTER_HANDOFF_PROMPT.md roadmap (by agent Kimi). Cycle 4 tech debt completed. v3.0.0 production-ready codebase with existing scaffold modules for auth (470 LOC, in-memory stubs), billing (750 LOC, dummy Stripe), analytics (771 LOC, local-only). Production infra (Docker, configs, deployment scripts, health checks, docs) all in place from Cycle 4.
thesis: Stop building infrastructure. Start serving users. Deploy v3.0.0 to Railway/Render. Replace in-memory auth stubs with Clerk. Replace local analytics with PostHog + Sentry. Replace dummy Stripe with live billing. After this: real users paying real money.

P0.label: DEPLOY — Get v3.0.0 running on a live URL with SSL, monitoring, and health checks
P0.note: Dockerfile.prod, docker-compose.prod.yml, deploy scripts, health checks all exist. Just need to wire to cloud provider.

P1.label: AUTH — Replace in-memory auth stubs with Clerk SDK. Login/signup/session/API-key flows
P1.note: src/core/auth/ has 470 LOC scaffold. Replace Map<string,User> with Clerk. Wire RBAC + SSO stubs to real provider.

P2.label: ANALYTICS + OBSERVABILITY — PostHog for product analytics, Sentry for errors, structured logging
P2.note: src/core/analytics/ has 771 LOC scaffold. Replace local event store with PostHog. Add Sentry for unhandled exceptions. Wire to dashboard.

P3.label: BILLING — Activate Stripe, wire usage metering, pricing tiers, subscription flows
P3.note: src/core/billing/ has 750 LOC scaffold with pricing-tiers.ts already defining Free/Pro/Enterprise. Replace dummy key with live Stripe. Add webhook handler.

P4.label: ONBOARDING + LAUNCH — User onboarding wizard, landing page, public launch checklist
P4.note: First 10 beta users. ProductHunt prep. Social announcement. README already polished from Cycle 4.

manual_actions_required: OWNER: Create Railway/Render account and link GitHub repo
OWNER: Create Clerk account → get CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY + CLERK_SECRET_KEY
OWNER: Create PostHog account → get POSTHOG_API_KEY + POSTHOG_HOST
OWNER: Create Sentry project → get SENTRY_DSN
OWNER: Create Stripe account → get STRIPE_SECRET_KEY + STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY + STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
OWNER: Register domain and point DNS to deployment
OWNER: Set up UptimeRobot monitors for /health endpoints
gate: Live URL responds 200 at /health. Clerk login/signup works. PostHog receiving events. Sentry catching errors. Stripe checkout completes test payment. Dashboard loads authenticated.
completion_criteria: Clerk: user can register, login, logout, get API key
RBAC: Free/Pro/Enterprise roles enforced on routes
PostHog: events visible in dashboard (page_view, ai_request, agent_run)
Sentry: test error appears in Sentry dashboard
Stripe: test checkout completes ($0 test mode)
Usage metering: token count, request count, agent count tracked per user
Billing dashboard: user sees plan, usage, invoices
Onboarding wizard: new user guided through first AI request
All existing tests still passing (no regressions)
